settings.text: Explore Our Range Kirstin Ash Product Range

Crafted from the finest metals and enhanced by intricate detailing and semi-precious gemstones, our range of necklaces embody a considered approach to style with a modern take on simplicity. Our pieces incorporate trending and classic styles, such as chain necklaces and choker necklaces, while our fine jewellery is coated in 9 karat gold or sterling silver.

Celebrate your uniqueness with one of Kirstin Ash’s zodiac necklaces. Emblazoned with motifs inspired by the night sky’s constellations, your zodiac necklace will serve as a reminder of your place and purpose in the universe. For a daintier design, look no further than the minimalism of our initial necklaces. Available in 18 karat gold vermeil, 18 karat rose gold vermeil, and sterling silver, these necklaces bring a personalised touch to any look, and are perfect for layering.

For a statement look, our gemstone and pearl necklaces are the answer. From captivating tigers eye to iridescent pearls, these designs will become your new essentials.

Many of our necklaces are engravable, making them ideal for personalisation or gifting.
